_comment: Human-assessed readiness. Every row MUST carry evidence a reader can check independently - a file path, a command, a commit, or a URL. A row with no evidence is not allowed to claim a percentage; set verified=false and say what is unknown. Live counts (tests, routes, models) are computed by build.php at generation time and are never stored here, because stored counts are exactly how the previous board drifted into fiction.
assessed_by: Claude session 2026-09-10, from direct filesystem and live-endpoint verification

areas.name: Stranded responder payouts
areas.evidence: Automated 2026-09-10 in commit f4e1781. Before it, releaseEscrow() wrote a ledger row marked completed and made no Stripe call - money stayed in the platform balance. Now performs a real /v1/transfers, records not-yet-payable responders as pending, and retries via urbangoodz:stranded-payouts-retry every 10 min.
